description: Kyojin: open-source engine that runs 100 GB-class open models (GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek V4.1) on one desktop machine. AMD Strix Halo, NVIDIA RTX and Apple Mac. OpenAI API, built on ExLlamaV3.
